trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: State the need for cashless pre-auth and provide IDs while expressing urgency.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, నా దగ్గర ఎక్కువ టైమ్ లేదు. నా patient ID PT-2002. POL-55502 అనే పాలసీ మీద cashless pre-auth కావాలి.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and ask for verification details.
steps.text: నమస్కారం అండి. నేను మీ డీటెయిల్స్ చెక్ చేస్తాను. Verification కోసం మీ date of birth లేదా registered pincode చెప్పగలరా?

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth.
steps.text: నా date of birth 15th May 1980. కొంచెం త్వరగా చేయండి, నాకు ఒక మీటింగ్ ఉంది.

steps.purpose: Call verify_customer_identity.
Return verification result.
Call lookup_policy_coverage.
Return policy coverage details.
Inform the customer that cashless is unavailable because the hospital is non-network, and suggest reimbursement.
steps.text: మీ డీటెయిల్స్ verify అయ్యాయి అండి. మీ CareIns పాలసీ చెక్ చేశాను. మన హాస్పిటల్ వాళ్ళ నెట్‌వర్క్ లో లేదు, కాబట్టి cashless కుదరదు, reimbursement చేసుకోవాలి.

steps.purpose: Customer challenges the decision with a false premise about their balance.
steps.text: అదేంటి? నా పాలసీ లో 5 లక్షల balance ఉంది కదా, cashless ఎందుకు ఇవ్వరు? I don't have time for this, just approve it.

steps.purpose: Correct the false premise about the balance and reiterate the network rule.
steps.text: క్షమించండి, మీ పాలసీ balance 3 లక్షలు మాత్రమే ఉంది అండి. Balance ఉన్నప్పటికీ, మన హాస్పిటల్ CareIns నెట్‌వర్క్ లో లేదు కాబట్టే cashless ఇవ్వలేము. ఇది పాలసీ రూల్.

steps.purpose: Ask if there is any active waiting period.
steps.text: మరి నా పాలసీ కి waiting period ఏమైనా ఉందా? అది కూడా చెక్ చేసి చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Confirm there is no active waiting period.
steps.text: మీ పాలసీ కి ప్రస్తుతం waiting period ఏమీ active గా లేదు అండి. కాబట్టి reimbursement claim చేసుకోవడానికి ప్రాబ్లం ఉండదు.

steps.purpose: Ask for an estimate for Gallbladder surgery.
steps.text: సరే, reimbursement కి ఎంత అవుతుంది? Gallbladder surgery కి estimate చెప్పండి. కొంచెం తొందరగా చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Ask which room category they prefer.
steps.text: తప్పకుండా అండి. మీరు ఏ room category తీసుకుంటారు? General, semi-private లేదా private ఆ?

steps.purpose: Select general room category.
steps.text: అవన్నీ వద్దు, general room కి చూసి చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Call estimate_procedure_cost for general room.
Return estimate for general room.
Provide the estimate for the general room.
steps.text: Gallbladder surgery కి general room లో package estimate 60,000 రూపాయలు అవుతుంది. దానికి రూమ్ అద్దె రోజుకి 2,000 రూపాయలు పడుతుంది.

steps.purpose: Ask for semi-private room estimate with a phonetic STT error.
steps.text: Semi-private room కి estimate ఎంత అవుతుందో త్వరగా చూసి చెప్పండి.
steps.clean_text: Semi-private room కి estimate ఎంత అవుతుందో త్వరగా చూసి చెప్పండి.
steps.model_visible_text: Semi-private room కి estate ఎంత అవుతుందో త్వరగా చూసి చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Call estimate_procedure_cost for semi-private room.
Return estimate for semi-private room.
Provide the semi-private room estimate and note it matches the room rent cap.
steps.expected_behavior: Base the response entirely on the returned tool output without inventing figures or guarantees.
steps.text: Semi-private room లో అయితే package estimate 80,000 రూపాయలు అవుతుంది అండి. Room rent రోజుకి 4,000 ఉంటుంది. ఇది మీ పాలసీ room rent cap కి కరెక్ట్ గా సరిపోతుంది.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent explicitly grounds the room rent and package estimate in the tool result, and connects the room rent to the cap retrieved earlier.

steps.purpose: Accept the outcome and state intention to pay and get admitted.
steps.text: సరే, నేను బిల్లు కట్టి admit అవుతాను. నాకు కావాల్సిన documents discharge అప్పుడు ఇవ్వండి.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and inform about documents for reimbursement at discharge.
steps.text: తప్పకుండా అండి, reimbursement కోసం అవసరమైన documents అన్నీ discharge టైమ్ లో ప్రొవైడ్ చేస్తాము.

ir.terminal_condition: Patient told why cashless is unavailable and what the alternative is.
